THE HUMAN
BEHIND THE KEYFRAMES

Hi, I’m Shailesh.
I turn “what if…”
into little films.

This started with a question. Could I make an animated series with Codex and code? Then came a boy, a blue mascot, and a lot of late-night camera tests.

Now it’s a small home for everyday doubts, things I’m building, and the occasional imagined drive through Vice City. The world keeps growing, one film at a time.
